SELECT cls,
  CAST(fished_date_doy/10 AS INT)*10 AS doy_bin,
  COUNT(*) AS boat_days,
  SUM(yt)/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season=2 AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 240 AND 330
  AND cls IN ('THREE_QUARTER','OVERNIGHT','DAY_1_5')
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT cls,
  CAST(fish_date_doy/10 AS INT)*10 AS doy_bin,
  COUNT(*) AS boat_days,
  SUM(yt)/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 230 AND 275
  AND cls IN ('three_quarter','overnight','day_1_5')
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2
